title: Clean, Quiet & Private Apt Close to Everything!
description:
Enjoy a very clean and cool apartment close to the airport, close to downtown, and close to the Opry. At the end of the day, retire to a quiet sanctuary within minutes of all locations. 
Basement apartment that is cool in the summer & warm in the winter. Private entrance with plenty of parking.
Cleanliness is assured as I clean it myself. Linens are bleached, and all surfaces are disinfected.

AIRBNB IS CHANGING LISTINGS WITHOUT INFORMING HOSTS. THIS APARTMENT HAS 1  BED THAT IS QUEEN-SIZED.

The space
The basement apartment gets sunlight but the windows are high and don't offer a view. Guests are welcome to use the patio. There is 1 queen size bed and a sofa that could sleep a child. The kitchen is fully outfitted and the laundry room is full-sized.

Guest access
The entrance is private and downstairs next to the garage doors.

Other things to note
The breaker box, water heater, and storm shelter are accessed through the apartment. Hopefully, access won't be needed but guests should be aware it could happen.
There are 2 cameras on the property. One is upstairs in the owner's place and one is in the garage.
